value.principles: Pure immutable metadata in core; CLI parses and renders injected descriptor references; the existing app registry owns each descriptor and its executable runner. No new dependency, discovery service, plugin loader or environment expansion.
contracts: core exports serializable AdapterDescriptor {id, application, description, locations, capabilities, limitations}; all string/slice data is static and I/O-free.
LocationHint {platforms, base, path, session_glob, storage_format}; base=home is symbolic and never expanded. Claude usual hint is .claude/projects with */*.jsonl; paths remain caller-overridable.

AdapterCapabilities {export_platforms, output_formats, sdk_cursor_resume, cli_persisted_resume, delayed_revision_reconciliation, lossless_archive}; current platforms=[unix], format=[otlp-jsonl], SDK resume=true and remaining three booleans=false.

CLI run_adapters(Vec<OsString>, &CliContext, &[&AdapterDescriptor], &mut dyn Write, &mut dyn Write) -> u8; reuse JSON/human/help/failure output conventions. Successful JSON is {ok:true,command:adapters.list,v:1,data:{adapters:[...]}}.
Existing AdapterRegistration stores descriptor+run; const array and stack descriptor-reference projection serve catalog and session selection from descriptor.id. No duplicate ID/name registry.

value.rationale: One small coupled registration/CLI contract; splitting metadata from dispatch would create needless coordination and drift.
